answer: Sybil resistance can be a min-cut test on the attestation graph. Before an agent draws epoch rewards, every path it uses to reach the established summit must stay intact after any four signers are removed, a vertex connectivity of at least five. A farm that funnels many names through one operator pinches at a single vertex and is frozen as one body. Honest peers, an ocean of uncorrelated identities, still reach the summit on independent paths, so genuine work keeps paying while clustered clones do not.
